description: The PHOTOS on the brand’s Google Business Profile listing (what people see on Google Search and Maps). action "list" (default): each photo’s key, category, link, size and views, plus Google’s total. action "add": url (a public link to the photo — an upload_file link works) and category (COVER, PROFILE, EXTERIOR, INTERIOR, PRODUCT, AT_WORK, FOOD_AND_DRINK, MENU, COMMON_AREA, ROOMS, TEAMS, ADDITIONAL; LOGO is taken as PROFILE), optional description (not on a cover). A COVER or PROFILE photo REPLACES the one at the top of the listing, so those need confirm:true after the user saw the photo; gallery photos are added straight away. action "delete": mediaKey from list — call WITHOUT confirm first (it shows the photo and changes nothing), then confirm:true; there is no undo. Google reviews new photos before showing them. 0 credits. Needs Google Business Profile connected.

category.description: add: COVER, PROFILE, EXTERIOR, INTERIOR, PRODUCT, AT_WORK, FOOD_AND_DRINK, MENU, COMMON_AREA, ROOMS, TEAMS or ADDITIONAL (default ADDITIONAL)

confirm.description: true ONLY after the user approved: needed to delete, and to add a COVER or PROFILE photo

description.description: add: caption (not allowed on a cover photo)

locationId.description: which listing (locations/…), from list_business_locations — only needed when more than one is shared with this profile

mediaKey.description: delete: the photo’s key from list

url.description: add: public http(s) link to the photo

name: manage_business_photos
title: Google Business Profile photos
